content_fields.title: Test session ID uniqueness and rotation after authentication
content_fields.description: Give each issued token a unique identifier and invalidate any prior session on authentication.
content_fields.finding: A new access token is minted with no session identifier, no jti and no invalidation of tokens issued before authentication.
criteria: Every token carries a unique jti, plus iat, iss and aud claims.
Two tokens issued for the same user are never identical.
Authentication invalidates any session identifier held before the login.
